title: That Awful Smell
text: That Awful Smell. WOW! They warn you in the instructions that the first time you use this it will smell. Boy howdy. I finally had to turn it off and go to my regular stove because the smell was unbearable. It does get very hot and seems to be controllable. The knobs seem to me to be  oriented oddly. It's like they couldn't decide which way was up or down and just put them on at an angle. Easy to clean. Will use it for cooing outside to try to mitigate the awful odor.
